actions.name: Chainsaw Prow
actions.text: DC 13, 1d4+3 slashing damage (see above)
actions.familyText: The Free Captain starship sinks its rotating blades into the hull of a starship within 0 zones. If Chainsaw Prow deals damage to the target's Hull Points, and the target is larger than the Free Captain starship, the Free Captain starship clings to the target. Until the start of the Free Captain starship's next turn, it moves with the target whenever the target moves.

actions.name: Cryo Corrosion
actions.text: When the Raider Rustbringer deals damage to a starship’s Hull Points with its zero hydro hose, the spray damages the target’s systems. The affected starship must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save; on a failure, one battle stations of the Rustbringer’s choice becomes malfunctioning. If the battle station is helmed, the creature helming it takes 2d6 cold damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save).

actions.name: Piercing Harpoon
actions.text: DC 19, 2d8 piercing damage (page 216)
actions.familyText: The Free Captain starship launches a harpoon at another starship within 1 zone. The target starship takes the listed piercing damage and attempts a Fortitude save against the listed DC. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target takes half damage. Failure The target takes full damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target starship to become malfunctioning. Critical Failure The target takes double damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target to become malfunctioning. Additionally, the harpoon causes a Hull Breach hazard to appear in a space adjacent to the malfunctioning battle station.
